user.title: Device Panel
user.description: Adds the Device Panel to the sidebar: all devices with outages, availability and software version.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Device Panel is already set up.

init.title: Settings
init.description: The same settings are available in the panel (gear icon), together with updates.

data_description.offline_after: Minutes without a sign of life before a device counts as offline. Shorter dropouts are not counted.
data_description.flaky_outages: An online device with this many outages in the last 24 hours is listed as unstable.
data_description.startup_grace: Minutes after Home Assistant starts in which returning devices had no outage. Time when Home Assistant was not running never counts as an outage.
data_description.exclude_integrations: Devices of these integrations are not shown in the panel and not monitored.
data_description.exclude_types: Devices of these types are not shown in the panel and not monitored. The type of a single device can be changed in its pop-up.
data_description.show_service_devices: Services of an integration rather than real devices, e.g. sun, weather forecast or add-ons. Shown service devices are monitored too.
data_description.show_disabled_devices: In their own group at the end of the list. They are not monitored.
data_description.update_check: Reports a new version under Settings → Repairs. Pre-releases are never reported here.

update_available.title: Device Panel {latest} is available
update_available.description: Installed is {installed}. Update via HACS or via the gear icon in the Device Panel (Settings). The daily check can be turned off in the options of the integration.
